Wait for a while. I need to get prepared.

lines.text: We're picking up rapidly fluctuating and shifting readings. Are you okay? Have you been injured?
I'm relieved to hear that. I knew this Protocol Space could be quite troublesome when Contingency Contract marked it.
SOW is still doing their best to find out more about Contingency Contract and what this organization is doing right now. Maybe they manipulated it remotely...
Are you saying that... Hmm... That is actually quite possible.
Data symmetry analysis showed imbalances between Æther properties and Originium properties of local sectors within the Protocol Space.
This would explain why the entire thing looked like a breached dam ... and the flood dyed the entire Protocol Space blue...
But this OOC event might be ... something that Contingency Contract wants to show you.
I have faith in your judgment...
Ugh. This entire thing is shrouded in mystery. Contingency Contract ... maybe something happened to the people working in CC.
Don't worry about this, Endmin... We'll constantly monitor this Protocol Space and keep you updated of any findings.

options: It would appear that it went out of control.
